name: performance_endpoint_call_time_with_mocked_processing
description: Performance test: measure endpoint time for a valid /query call with process_query mocked to return quickly.
input: Use TestClient to POST /query with a valid payload; monkeypatch _agent.process_query to AsyncMock(return_value='Perf endpoint result').
output: HTTP response received within threshold; status 200
error_scenarios: endpoint slower due to event loop scheduling
mocking fails and causes longer delays
